title: Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
main_claim: Over any characteristic-zero field, every syntactically homogeneous ΣΠΣΠΣ circuit computing IMM_{n,n} needs at least n^{√n/400} gates, and bottom support is unrestricted. A block construction gives n^{√n+4}, so the complexity is n^{Θ(√n)}.
coverage:
I read every section (02–06 and the figure) line by line and checked each step by hand.

Section 2 (rank measure and parameters):
- The parameter lemma: α ≥ n^{-1/2}, the bounds on β relative to α^ρ, and the estimates for q.

Section 3 (circuit upper bound):
- Product-rank lemma: applying the factors with δ_j > 0 first and bounding the rank by the intermediate dimension is valid. I checked the binomial-ratio bounds and the identity I − ρJ = (1+ρ)/2 · Σ|δ_j|, which uses λ = ρ(1−λ).
- H_e ≤ q^{d_e}(1 + 4q^{1−2d_e}).
- Low-degree distances. The odd-degree bound H_e ≤ q^{d_e/2} holds because d_e ≥ 3/8 and q ≤ n^{-2/5}.
- Summing the even-degree corrections uses log-convexity of f(z); I checked f(2) and f(t0).
- All-low case: the saving is q^{s/4}.
- High-degree case: expanding one occurrence gives the factor S. I checked the 5^{4s} term, the bound H_1^e ≤ q^{λe/2}, and the exponent 3/160 ≥ 1/100.
- Layer structure: bottom sums are linear forms or scalars, and repeated predecessors are merged.

Section 4 (moments):
- Occupation-moment identity, by coefficient extraction, and its ratio to geometric moments.
- The lower-comparison loss is O(n^{-1/2}).
- First-trace identity: the shifts are distinct, so there are no cross terms.
- The four-path trace formula and the N/D type dichotomy.
- The local polynomial table, including validity of indices at M', and its falling-factorial nonnegativity.
- Geometric normalizations. For example, (2A²+A)/A² = 1 + α^{-1} and (2B+1)/(B+1) = 1 + β.
- The relaxed count n^{2L−w}, and that the V-layer equality events are independent because no two V layers are adjacent.

Section 5 (word sum):
- The isolated-flip ratio (1+α)/n² and the preimage count.
- The endpoint correction.
- Interval discrepancy d(I) ≤ 1+ρ for the balanced schedule, which gives a weight of at most n per D-run.
- Switch accounting w = 2r + e and the bound Σ_r C(n−1, 2r+e) n^{-r} ≤ n² e^{√n}.
- The two constant words.

Section 6 (completion):
- Combining the two rank bounds gives S ≥ n^{√n/400}.
- Transfer to characteristic zero: the matrix is integral, so the rank is the same over every characteristic-zero field.
- Arithmetic of the upper-bound gate count, including n = 2.
sibling_notes: The family-135 board was empty when I checked. The paper cites AGKST (residues) and LST, but its proof doesn't rely on any companion paper.
